label: Fine-particle air pollution, PM2.5 (ug/m3)
definition: Annual mean PM2.5 where people live, ug/m3, 2021 (population-weighted; LGHAP v2 1 km)
publisher: Bai et al. (2024), LGHAP v2, Earth System Science Data; Zenodo 14280025
currency_note: We use the monthly-mean record (Zenodo 14280025), which stops at 2021; no monthly or annual PM2.5 record past 2021 was found. The 2022-2024 releases are daily grids, 12 zips of about 1.1 GB per year (13.8 GB for 2024): over the 1 GB limit for this pass, so recorded as a lead, not built. CC BY 4.0, gridded, machine-readable.
